Standard: The means of opening and weight of each removable emergency hatch or door can be accomplished by the entire intended anthropometric population. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
(1) Ground or Lab test: Testing in a representative mock-up or on the air vehicle shows that emergency egress doors are operable from inside and outside the air vehicle by the full expected range of user anthropometric reach and strength values in MIL-STD-1472, Anthropometric Accommodation paragraph and MIL-STD-1472, Static Muscle Strength table in Push and Pull Forces paragraphs.
